versions.changelog:
- Clarifies that the skill provides guidance and templates only, with no requirement to execute third-party code.
- Updates account onboarding instructions to focus on documentation-based guidance rather than direct automation.
- Marks CLI and Telegram bots as optional external examples, requiring explicit user approval before any code execution.
- Emphasizes direct API/WebSocket guidance, with external tooling treated as optional and not required.
- Provides clearer, safer onboarding instructions and recommends sandbox/manual review for any external code.

- Added support for self-onboarding via wallet creation/connection and exchange credential issuance.
- Updated instructions for existing wallet connection to reference local environment file setup.
- Clarified language: "private keys or secrets" changed to "sensitive credentials".
- Improved description and onboarding steps for account creation and credential handling.
- No code or file changes; documentation updates only.
Initial Release. Operate Quote.Trade as a DEX for AI agents, crypto exchange for AI agents, and AI native exchange.
